desc: Implement BFS distances from S and T and the degree-based vertex-gadget candidate computation with local costs 2/4.
Implement biconnected component decomposition (Tarjan) and identify non-bridge components.
Implement the simple-cycle block candidate using best distinct distS/distT pair.
Implement the vertex-split min-cost 2-flow candidate for non-simple non-bridge blocks, with potentials and two augmentations.
Integrate all candidates, add pruning/lower-bound skips if needed, and handle large recursion/iterative DFS safely.
Validate against the samples and small random brute-force configuration BFS cases.
